AbyssME runs Java ME games, Mophun and experimental Symbian / N-Gage games on Android phones and gaming handhelds. Games and phone system files are not included.
AbyssME runs Java ME and Mophun games on Android phones and gaming handhelds. This build does not include the Symbian / N-Gage engine. Games are not included.
Library\nAdd your game files or choose a game folder. Select a game to play; its actions include controls, display settings and artwork. Compatibility varies by game and edition.

Controls\nUse a physical controller or the on-screen Phone keys / Gamepad. Open Controls to choose a template or change bindings for the current game. Hold Select on a controller to open mapping while playing.

Picture and performance\nOpen the game menu for Display settings. Try changes before keeping them. If a picture preset is too slow, return to a simpler preset. Restart game is available if a screen change leaves the picture blank; unsaved progress may be lost.
Games and saves\nUse Library transfer to back up or restore an AbyssME library, or import from J2ME Loader. Keep a backup before moving data. A game screenshot is not a saved game.

Symbian / N-Gage\nAdd your own compatible phone system files in System files. Some games also need the N-Gage 2.0 platform installer or components. The import screen explains what is missing; a game archive is not a phone system dump.

Online play\nFluxer rooms and Java Bluetooth play over the internet are early experimental features with low compatibility. Both players need the same supported game edition. An available lobby does not guarantee that a game or network will work.
